onboarding.body: Your agency is where your sites, team and reports come together.
onboarding.name: Agency name
onboarding.errorAlready: You already belong to an agency.
onboarding.errorName: Give your agency a name of at least 2 characters.

invite.loginFirst: Sign in or create an account with {email} to accept the invitation.
invite.errorInvalid: This invitation is invalid, has expired or has already been used.
invite.errorMismatch: This invitation is for a different email address. Sign out and sign in with the invited address.

dashboard.trialBanner: Trial: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}.
dashboard.readOnlyBanner: Your trial or subscription has ended. Monitoring continues, but new sites and updates are blocked.

sitesNew.title: Add site
sitesNew.name: Name
sitesNew.errorUrl: Enter a valid web address, for example https://client.com.
sitesNew.errorEmail: Enter a valid email address or leave the field empty.
sitesNew.errorDuplicate: This site is already in your agency.

sitesNew.errorInactive: Your trial or subscription has ended. You can add new sites again once your subscription is active.
sitesNew.errorForbidden: Only owners and admins can add sites.

siteDetail.connectIntro: Connect the site with a one-time code. The code is valid for 30 minutes and works only once.
siteDetail.step1: Download the Verploy Connector and install it on the site: Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin.
siteDetail.step2: In WordPress, go to Settings → Verploy.
siteDetail.step3: Paste the connection code and click Connect.
siteDetail.waiting: Waiting for the plugin… This page refreshes automatically once the site is connected.
siteDetail.repairBody: Needed after reinstalling the plugin, or if you want to replace this site's key. The current connection keeps working until the new code is used.
siteDetail.updatesAvailable: {count, plural, one {# update available} other {# updates available}}
siteDetail.componentsEmpty: No data yet. It appears after the first heartbeat.
siteDetail.dangerBody: Removes the site and all its data from Verploy. The plugin on the site will stop reporting.
siteDetail.deleteConfirm: Type the site name ({name}) to confirm.

settings.title: Agency settings
settings.name: Agency name
settings.errorColor: Use a hex code such as #22D98A.

team.title: Team
team.roleHelp: Owners manage everything, including team and subscription. Admins manage sites. Members can view everything.
team.inviteLinkHelp: Share this link. It's valid for 7 days and only works for this email address.
team.errorLastOwner: An agency must have at least one owner.
team.errorAlreadyMember: This person is already a member of your agency.
